questions.q: What is the range of the data set: $84, 37, 93, 17, 57, 98$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $81$. Applying One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error principles, Range $= \max-\min = 98-17=81$ Therefore, the verified correct option is 81.

questions.q: In a survey, 40% of 200 students prefer math. How many students prefer math?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $80$. Multiply the percentage by the total number of students: $0.40 \times 200 = 80$ students.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The table shows test scores for two classes. What is the positive difference between the medians?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $1$. Median A = 81; Median B = 82. Difference = 1.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The mean of $4$ numbers is $36$. When one more number, $31$, is added to the set, what is the new mean of all $5$ numbers?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $35$. Original sum $=36\times 4=144$. New sum $=144+31=175$. New mean $=\frac{175}{5}=35$

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Foundational Fluency (21–28)

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the mode of the data set: $20, 19, 45, 43, 20, 12$?
questions.answer: The value $20$ appears twice, more often than any other value, so it is the mode.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the median of the following list of numbers: $3, 7, 12, 15, 19, 24, 30$?
questions.answer: The ordered list has 7 values. The middle (4th) value is 15.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The mean of four numbers is 18. Three of the numbers are 12, 16, and 22. What is the fourth number?
questions.answer: Total sum = $4 \times 18 = 72$. Sum of three = $12 + 16 + 22 = 50$. Fourth number = $72 - 50 = 22$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The heights of 5 basketball players in inches are 74, 76, 78, 80, and 82. What is the mean height?
questions.answer: Sum = $390$. Mean = $390 / 5 = 78$ inches.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: A scientist measured the weekly rainfall in millimeters over seven weeks: 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, and 20. What was the median weekly rainfall?
questions.answer: The middle value in this ordered list of 7 numbers is 11.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the range of the set: $5, 5, 5, 5, 5$?
questions.answer: Because all elements in the set are identical, the maximum is 5 and the minimum is 5. Thus the range is $5 - 5 = 0$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the mean of the numbers: $10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60$?

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: A data set has minimum value 24 and range 36. What is the maximum value?
questions.answer: Maximum = Minimum + Range = $24 + 36 = 60$.

questions.q: A biologist recorded the weights of six laboratory mice in grams: 14, 28, 19, 45, 12, and 33. What is the range of these weights?
questions.answer: Range = Maximum - Minimum = $45 - 12 = 33$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the median of the following even-sized data set: $4, 9, 11, 15, 18, 24$?
questions.answer: The middle two numbers are 11 and 15. The median is their average: $(11 + 15)/2 = 13$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the range of the scores: $85, 92, 78, 95, 88$?
questions.answer: Applying One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error principles, Range = $95 - 78 = 17$. Therefore, the verified correct option is 17.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: A frequency table shows the number of siblings reported by 20 students. The results are shown in the table. What is the mode of the number of siblings?
questions.answer: The sibling count with the highest frequency (8 students) is 1.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: In a class of 25 students, the median test score is 84. If 12 students scored above 84, how many students scored at or below 84?
questions.answer: Total students = 25. If 12 scored above 84, then $25 - 12 = 13$ scored at or below 84.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The temperature in degrees Celsius over 5 days was: $-2, 0, 4, 7, 11$. What was the median temperature?
questions.answer: Ordered list has middle value 4°C.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: If the mean of three numbers is 10, what is the sum of the three numbers?
questions.answer: Applying One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error principles, Sum = $3 \times 10 = 30$. Therefore, the verified correct option is 30.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: A teacher recorded the number of questions answered correctly by eight students: 4, 8, 8, 12, 15, 15, 15, and 20. What is the mode of these scores?
questions.answer: The value 15 appears most frequently (3 times).

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: A survey asked 150 students how many hours per week they read. The results are shown in the table. How many students read at least 6 hours per week?
questions.answer: At least 6 hours includes '6–8' (40) and '9+' (15): $40 + 15 = 55$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: If five quiz scores have a sum of 420, what is the mean score?
questions.answer: Applying One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error principles, Mean = $420 / 5 = 84$. Therefore, the verified correct option is 84.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: The mean of five test scores is 82. If four of the scores are 80, 85, 75, and 90, what is the fifth score?
questions.answer: Total needed = $5 \times 82 = 410$. Current sum = $80 + 85 + 75 + 90 = 330$. Fifth score = $410 - 330 = 80$.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: Find the median of the data set: $18, 22, 14, 30, 26$.
questions.answer: Order the data: 14, 18, 22, 26, 30. The middle value is 22.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the mode of the values: $12, 15, 18, 15, 21, 15, 18$?
questions.answer: 15 appears 3 times, which is more than any other value.

questions.target: Mean, Median, Range, Standard Deviation & Margin of Error
questions.q: What is the median of: $50, 60, 70, 80$?
questions.answer: Applying One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error principles, Average of 60 and 70 is 65. Therefore, the verified correct option is 65.
